description: One directory from the index: domain rating, dofollow, price, category, the submission page URL (or where to look for it), account_required (the page redirected to a sign-in when probed — most rows want a sign-in at submit anyway), founder_fills (a form an agent cannot drive), the note from the last session that worked it, and — for a project — the outcome already recorded. Read the note before opening the page. Read-only.
